name: Aihara Takuya
source: Once again, [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s misadventure of transforming himself into an opposite gender is drawing attention at Miyanomori High School. The ever-present problem with Takuya is that he never really learns from his past mistakes and it looks like he is eager to repeat them often. [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]Last year[/url] mingling with the chemistry club didn't really bring him anything good so the reason as to why he decided to stay in it and even become its president is not known nor unterstood by anybody but him. You could say that his fellow [url=https://vndb.org/c63687]underclassman[/url] from the chemistry club couldn't have hoped for a better guinea pig out there for her newest experiment. Will Takuya survive another girl transformation adventure is yet to be seen.
